critical_triggers.description: Hacking, unauthorized account takeover, stolen credentials
Battery fire, explosion, burn injury, smoke, electric shock
Unauthorized financial charges, disputed bank debits > $50

high_triggers.description: Mentions of attorney, lawyer, lawsuit, sue, court action
Mentions of FTC, BBB, Consumer Protection Bureau
Multiple failed attempts, chronic unresolved incident
Explicit refusal of AI assistance, request for human operator

medium_triggers.description: Message includes credit card, phone number, IMEI, or email

low_confidence_escalation.description: If intent classification confidence < 0.60, escalate to Human-in-the-Loop review
